verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable workflow platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents telemetry, usage tracking, or any way to disable them. Self-hosting and encryption of variables are adjacent privacy features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
